findings.problem: Job-list skills/location/source filter semantics undefined (which skill set, normalization, None entries, case sensitivity).
findings.fix: skills: <=10 entries, normalize_skill each, None -> 422, job matches if any entry in required ∪ preferred; location: 1-100 chars, casefold substring via escaped ilike; source: single enum value.

findings.problem: PATCH with a disallowed transition: unspecified whether other fields in the same request are persisted.
findings.fix: Reject the whole PATCH; persist no fields; run transition() before applying field changes.

findings.problem: Says raise UpstreamUnavailableError, whose code in errors.py is UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE; R10.7 requires INGESTION_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.
findings.fix: Raise IngestionSourceUnavailableError; add API test asserting the code.

findings.problem: No CORSMiddleware designed or installed although frontend (5173) calls backend (8000) cross-origin; VITE_API_BASE_URL default unstated.
findings.fix: Add CORSMiddleware(allow_origins=settings.cors_origins, allow_credentials=False, methods GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, headers Content-Type/X-Demo-User/X-Request-ID, expose X-Request-ID); VITE_API_BASE_URL default http://localhost:8000/api; preflight API tests; add task.

findings.problem: Activity event types listed without exact triggers (unset/no-op bookmark, status+field PATCH, jobs_ingested user for CLI).
findings.fix: Add trigger table: bookmark/hide only false->true; status_changed on real change; application_updated only for non-status-only PATCH; jobs_ingested one per run attributed to request user or seed_key='demo' user for CLI, none if absent.

findings.problem: ALIASES includes ci/cd -> ci/cd, contradicting 'alias value is not an alias key'.
NFKC then casefold is not guaranteed idempotent for all Unicode.
Ambiguous term R matches 'R&D' and initials.
findings.fix: For r/c reject following '&' or '. '; add unit tests.

findings.problem: Error-code list lacks NOT_READY, UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE, METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED, BAD_REQUEST, UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, HTTP_ERROR used by §14/errors.py.
ilike escaping of %/_ (security steering) not stated in design.
findings.fix: State escape rule for q and location; add test q='100%'.
List mutable vs immutable (source, external_id, discovered_at) fields.
